/bin/zsh -lc "ls -la | head -50 && cat core/discov/config.go && cat core/discov/internal/etcdclient.go && sed -n '1,100p' core/discov/config_test.go && cat go.mod | head -30"

/bin/zsh -lc "cat zrpc/config.go && sed -n '1,120p' zrpc/server.go && sed -n '1,100p' zrpc/client.go && sed -n '1,100p' zrpc/internal/resolver/discovbuilder.go && sed -n '1,100p' core/discov/subscriber.go && sed -n '1,90p' core/discov/publisher.go"

/bin/zsh -lc 'gofmt -w core/discov/config.go core/discov/internal/vars.go core/discov/internal/registry.go core/discov/subscriber.go core/discov/publisher.go zrpc/client.go zrpc/config.go zrpc/internal/target.go zrpc/internal/resolver/discovbuilder.go zrpc/internal/rpcpubserver.go zrpc/server.go && git diff --stat && git diff -- core/discov/internal/registry.go zrpc/internal/target.go zrpc/internal/rpcpubserver.go'
/bin/zsh -lc "cat core/discov/internal/vars.go && sed -n '1,65p' zrpc/config.go && sed -n '1,90p' core/discov/subscriber.go && git diff --check && git status --short"

/bin/zsh -lc "nl -ba core/discov/config.go | head -22 && nl -ba core/discov/internal/registry.go | sed -n '35,100p;250,275p;330,370p' && nl -ba zrpc/internal/target.go | sed -n '12,40p' && nl -ba zrpc/server.go | sed -n '38,50p'"
